steps.en: PLUS can send OCMS a revive request with a reason
steps.id: PLUS bisa mengirim request revive beserta alasan ke OCMS

steps.en: Only the two reasons PLUS may use are accepted
steps.id: Hanya dua alasan yang boleh dipakai PLUS yang diterima

steps.en: Each notice is checked to see whether revival is allowed
steps.id: Tiap notice dicek apakah revival boleh dilakukan

steps.en: PLUS can ask whether a revival would be allowed before doing it
steps.id: PLUS bisa menanyakan apakah revival akan diizinkan sebelum menjalankannya
steps.why_en: The check-only answer is looser than the real revival, so it can say yes and still fail.
steps.why_id: Jawaban cek-saja lebih longgar dari revival sebenarnya, jadi bisa bilang boleh tapi tetap gagal.

steps.en: The reason PLUS gives is saved with the revival
steps.id: Alasan dari PLUS disimpan bersama revival

steps.en: PLUS requests reach OCMS safely and reliably
steps.id: Request PLUS sampai ke OCMS dengan aman dan andal
steps.why_en: The entry point has no login check in the application and the connection fault cannot be confirmed.
steps.why_id: Pintu masuknya tidak punya cek login di aplikasi dan gangguan koneksinya tidak bisa dipastikan.
